items.title: 12.9 Kaainat mein matter aur antimatter ki adam-tanasub (asymmetry) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.9 (PDF 274) in the book's order, with a note and a self-check.

blocks.text: Bohat se mushahidat (observations) batate hain ke kaainat mein matter aur antimatter barabar nahi (asymmetry); yeh hamari kaainat ki sab se hairat-angez baaton mein se hai. Kai mafroozat (hypotheses) hain jo dikhate hain ke kaainat taqreeban poori matter se bani hai, antimatter se nahi. Maslan kitab ke mutabiq kaainat ka taqreeban 5% aam maadda (electrons, protons, neutrons) hai, aur is aam maadde mein taqreeban 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium hai; kaainat mein antihydrogen ya antihelium atoms ka koi hissa nahi milta.

Kitab likhti hai ke tajurbat batate hain ke yeh asymmetry baryon number ki conservation toot jane (violation) se hai, yani baryons aur anti-baryons ki tadaad barabar nahi rahi. Agar particle-antiparticle symmetry bhi toote to aisa nizam ban sakta hai jo antiquarks se zyada quarks, antileptons se zyada leptons aur aakhir mein antimatter se zyada matter banaye. Is liye nateeja yeh hai ke matter aur antimatter ki asymmetry ka masla abhi tak raaz (mystery) hai. (Note: baryon number ka tootna abhi tak kisi tajurbe mein nahi dekha gaya; yeh ek mafrooza hai.)

blocks.title: Ek hal-talab masla
blocks.text: Kaainat mein taqreeban koi antimatter kyun nahi, yeh physics ke bare jawab-talab sawalon mein se hai; upar ki wazahatein mafroozat (hypotheses) hain, sabit shuda nataij nahi.

blocks.prompt: Wajahein bataiye ke hamari kaainat taqreeban poori matter se kyun bani hai (comprehensive question 12.3). Matter aur antimatter ki adam-tanasub kin zarron ki tadaad ke adam-tawazun se hai (MCQ 12.16)?
blocks.explanation: Agar Big Bang ke baad matter aur antimatter bilkul barabar bante to aapas mein fana ho kar radiation ban jate; jo matter hum dekhte hain woh batata hai ke matter ki nanhi si zyadati bach gayi. Tajweez shuda wajahein aise amal hain jo baryon number baqi nahi rakhte aur zarron aur antizarron se thora mukhtalif sulook karte hain, ta ke antiquarks se zyada quarks aur antileptons se zyada leptons banein; asal wajah abhi tak muamma hai. MCQ 12.16: (c), baryons.

items: Kaainat taqreeban poori matter hai: antihydrogen ya antihelium nahi milta (kitab: aam maadda taqreeban 5%, us mein 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium).
Mumkina wajah: baryon number aur particle-antiparticle symmetry ka tootna; masla abhi tak hal nahi hua.
